draft.summary: Decide how customers are notified when an order is ready
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Spike (created as Task; this Jira project has no Spike type).

Proposed owner (from the meeting): Camila Torres.

Phase: 2.

The team could not say whether customers get a notification when an order is Ready for pickup.

## Question and Deliverable
Decide which channel announces a ready order: email, SMS, or the status page only. Deliverable: the decision recorded, and a follow-up ticket if a notification is chosen.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Channel decided** (Happy path) — The marketing lead has answered. Expected: the chosen channel is recorded in the meeting notes, and a follow-up ticket exists if email or SMS was chosen.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
The order status page does not wait for this answer.

## Completion Checklist
- [ ] Question answered.
- [ ] Findings documented.
- [ ] Decision or recommendation recorded.
- [ ] Follow-up tickets created, if applicable.

## Completion Evidence
Pending — to be linked as it becomes available.
